title: Transistor fails when it overheats or its collector current is too high

implements.text: The transistor latches burnt when Tj = 25 + theta * P exceeds tjmax (default 150 degC, theta 200 degC per W) or the peak collector current exceeds 1.5 times icmax (default 1 A); above 0.75 times pmax it is reported hot

mocked.text: Once the rule fires the part stays burnt until it is repaired; the real part may survive or fail more slowly

unsupported.text: Thermal history; only the threshold and its dwell are checked

validation.dataset: figures/engine/bench-solve.test.mjs: pin and motor swapped: the motor hangs on the base, and the TIP120 reports overdrive

operatingRange.evidence: hot state starts at 0.75 times the default pmax of 0.6 W (bench-solve.js:343)

knownFailureCases: theta: the thermal resistance is a default, not the part's datasheet figure
